newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: City Lodge raises half yr shr, div.
newsitem.headline: City Lodge raises half yr shr, div.

text.p: Half year ended Dec 31, 1996 (million rand unless stated)
Full name: City Lodge Hotels Ltd

NOTE - Directors will award capitalisation shares to shareholders in the ratio that the dividend bears to the issue price. This price was defined as the weighted average of the traded prices of shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange for the three days ending March 26, discounted by seven percent.

Looking ahead directors said they expected acceptable earnings growth for the year following the opening of two new hotels and the continued success of the group's service excellence programme and innovative marketing drive.
Three new hotels currently under construction would contribute to earnings in the second half of the 1998 financial year.
